oracle: I4 (C5, deletion wins): a paragraph deleted while another editor types into it, and every token typed into it, are gone on every peer; the deletion took exactly that element
what: applyRemote never applies a delta that only deletes children (app/src/crdt/sync.ts), so the paragraph a peer deleted stays in the other copies with the tokens typed into it

target.case: C5 delete a paragraph while N−1 type into it: deletion wins, so the paragraph and every token typed into it are gone on every peer (I4), and the session converges (I1) [N=2]
